drivers.label: Early-down success
drivers.cue: Watch Wyoming on 1st down: gaining 4 or more yards keeps them out of 3rd-and-long. If Wyoming does that often, Wyoming's offense is winning this matchup; if not, UConn's defense is.

detail.meaning: How often the offense has a successful play on normal downs: every 1st down, 2nd-and-7 or shorter, and 3rd or 4th-and-4 or shorter, on any set of downs in a drive (not just the first two plays). Successful means gaining half the yards needed on 1st down, 70% on 2nd, and all of it on 3rd or 4th.
detail.why: One of the 5 stats the model found actually decide games. Since 2015, when one team's offense or defense was ahead in this matchup (this offense against this defense), that team won 62% of the time.

drivers.label: Early-down success
drivers.cue: Watch UConn on 1st down: gaining 4 or more yards keeps them out of 3rd-and-long. If UConn does that often, UConn's offense is winning this matchup; if not, Wyoming's defense is.

detail.meaning: How often the offense has a successful play on normal downs: every 1st down, 2nd-and-7 or shorter, and 3rd or 4th-and-4 or shorter, on any set of downs in a drive (not just the first two plays). Successful means gaining half the yards needed on 1st down, 70% on 2nd, and all of it on 3rd or 4th.
detail.why: One of the 5 stats the model found actually decide games. Since 2015, when one team's offense or defense was ahead in this matchup (this offense against this defense), that team won 62% of the time.

drivers.label: Big plays
drivers.cue: Watch for Wyoming plays of 20 or more yards; one or two can decide it. If Wyoming does that often, Wyoming's offense is winning this matchup; if not, UConn's defense is.

detail.meaning: How big the good plays are: the average points added on the offense's successful plays. High numbers mean chunk gains, not just steady ones.
detail.why: One of the 5 stats the model found actually decide games. On its own it's close to a coin flip (since 2015, when one team's offense or defense was ahead in this matchup, that team won 51% of the time), but next to the other stats it adds real weight.

drivers.label: Points added per run
drivers.cue: Watch for UConn runs of 10 or more yards against Wyoming. If UConn does that often, UConn's offense is winning this matchup; if not, Wyoming's defense is.

detail.meaning: Points added per run: how much the average run moves the offense toward scoring, based on down, distance and field position. Above zero helps the offense.
detail.why: One of the 5 stats the model found actually decide games. Since 2015, when one team's offense or defense was ahead in this matchup (this offense against this defense), that team won 59% of the time.
